fields.label: Badge Image
fields.description: The badge icon/graphic shown on the learner's profile.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: What this badge represents. e.g., "Awarded for completing GDPR Compliance Training"

fields.label: Criteria Type
fields.options:
Module Completion
Score Based
Manual Award
fields.description: Module Completion — auto-awarded when module is finished. Score Based — awarded only if learner scores above threshold. Manual Award — Admin manually gives this badge.

fields.label: Module
fields.description: The module this badge is tied to. Visible when criteria_type is "Module Completion" or "Score Based".

fields.label: Minimum Score
fields.description: Visible only when criteria_type is "Score Based". Learner must score this or above to earn the badge.

fields.label: Is Active
fields.description: Toggle to enable or disable is active.
